Neopentane has a highly symmetrical structure with four identical CH₃ groups attached to a central carbon atom. A.text: Three numbers form a Geometric Progression. If the 3^rd term is decreased by 64, then the three numbers thus obtained will constitute an Arithmetic progression. a, ar, ar^2 are in G.P. a, ar, ar^2 - 64 are in A.P., we get ⇒ a(r^2 - 2r + 1) = 64 ........ (i)
Again, a, ar - 8, ar^2 - 64 are in G.P.

Trick: Check by alternates according to conditions

A.subject: Mathematics
A.text: The number of real solutions of the equation |x² + 4x + 3| + 2x + 5 = 0 are
A.sol_text:
Answer : (2)
Solution:
Here two cases arise viz.

Case I : x² + 4x + 3 > 0
This gives x² + 4x + 3 + 2x + 5 = 0
⇒ x² + 6x + 8 = 0 ⇒ (x + 2)(x + 4) = 0 ⇒ x = −2, −4

x = −2 is not satisfying the condition x² + 4x + 3 > 0 , so x = −4 is the only solution of the given equation.

Case II : x² + 4x + 3 < 0
This gives −(x² + 4x + 3) + 2x + 5 = 0
⇒ −x² − 2x + 2 = 0 ⇒ x² + 2x − 2 = 0
⇒ (x + 1 + √3)(x + 1 − √3) = 0
